meta.parties: Livera Et Al v. Abeyesinghe Et Al

rules.statement: A mala fide possessor is not entitled to compensation for useful improvements.
rules.supporting_quote: "I agree to the order proposed by my brother Ennis." and "The decision of this Court in The General Ceylon Tea Estates Co., Ltd., v. Pulle 2 [(1907) 9 N. L. R. 98.] is an express authority binding upon us, that a mala fide possessor is not entitled to compensation for useful improvements"
